WITH color_totals AS (
  SELECT p.product_color AS product_color,
         SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) AS invoiced_amount
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_color
),
shares AS (
  SELECT product_color,
         invoiced_amount,
         invoiced_amount * 1.0 / SUM(invoiced_amount) OVER () AS share,
         AVG(invoiced_amount) OVER () AS avg_per_color
  FROM color_totals
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT * FROM shares
  WHERE invoiced_amount > avg_per_color
)
SELECT AVG(invoiced_amount) AS avg_invoiced_amount,
       AVG(share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(invoiced_amount - avg_per_color) AS avg_amount_above_per_color_average
FROM above_avg;
